row 9: 5,5,0,0,5
row 10: 5,5,0,0,5
row 11: 5,5,5,5,5

row 8: 5,5,5,5,5
row 9: 5,5,0,0,5
row 10: 5,5,0,0,5
row 11: 5,5,5,5,5
Yes! It is a 2x2 square interior, completely enclosed by 5s!

Shape 3 (right):
rows 4 to 9, cols 7 to 11:
row 4: 5,5,5,5,5
row 5: 5,0,0,0,5
row 6: 5,0,0,0,5
row 7: 5,0,0,0,5
row 8: 5,0,0,5,5
row 9: 5,5,5,5,5
The interior 0s are not square (rows 5-7 have 3 zeros, row 8 has 2 zeros).

So ONLY the 2x2 square in the bottom-left shape has a square interior!
